scalars.scalar_value: EDUCATION: Completion of a Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university, in an area related to the assignment. NOTE: Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for up to two years of the required education on a year-for-year basis. Have an equity-minded focus, responsiveness, and sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students, including those with physical or learning disabilities as it relates to differences in learning styles; and successfully foster and support an inclusive educational and employment environment. ( Experience Requirement : One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Education Requirement: One year of education is equal to 30 semester units.) Education must be from an accredited institution.
EXPERIENCE: Two years of related experience in student services on a college campus or in a community agency that provides comparable services to students or diverse community members.

items.item_text: 01. Please indicate how you meet the education qualification for the Student Support Specialist position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. NOTE: One year of education is equal to 30 semester (45 quarter) units. Education must be from an accredited institution. Education used to meet the minimum qualification must be clearly stated in the application. If using completion of quarter/semester units to meet the minimum qualification, it must be clearly stated in the Education section of the application. Missing information may result in the education not being counted. Options: I have a Bachelor's degree or higher from an accredited institution. | I have completed three (3) years (90 semester/135 quarter units) of college course work from an accredited institution. | I have completed an Associate degree OR 60 semester (90 quarter) units of college course work from an accredited institution. | I have completed LESS THAN 60 semester (90 quarter) units of college course work from an accredited institution.

02. Please indicate how you meet the experience qualification for the Student Support Specialist position by selecting the option that best describes your qualifications. NOTE: One year of experience is equal to 12 months of experience at 40 hours per week. Applicable part-time experience will be converted to the full-time equivalent for purposes of meeting the experience requirement. Experience used to meet the minimum qualifications must be clearly stated in the application. Missing documentation may result in the experience not being counted. Options: I have four (4) years or more of full-time equivalent experience in student services on a college campus or in a community agency that provides comparable services to students or diverse community members. | I have three (3) years of full-time equivalent experience in student services on a college campus or in a community agency that provides comparable services to students or diverse community members. | I have two (2) years of full-time equivalent experience in student services on a college campus or in a community agency that provides comparable services to students or diverse community members. | I have LESS THAN two (2) years experience in student services on a college campus or in a community agency that provides comparable services to students or diverse community members.

03. Minimum Qualification Verification Agreement I understand that if selected for hire, I will be required to submit official transcripts, licenses/certificates, and verification of qualifying work experience, as applicable. Options: Yes, I understand and agree. | No, I do not agree.
